items.title: Solana outage knocks 90 validators offline – Was the network at risk?
items.whyYouShouldCare: The recent outage affecting 90 validators raises concerns about Solana's network stability and its implications for user confidence and ecosystem growth.

items.title: A Routing Bug Took Solana 86% of the Way to Losing Finality
items.whyYouShouldCare: The routing bug that nearly compromised finality highlights potential vulnerabilities in Solana's infrastructure, which could impact transaction reliability and user trust.

items.title: MoneyGram Ramps launches on Solana
items.whyYouShouldCare: MoneyGram's integration with Solana enhances the ecosystem's utility, potentially increasing transaction volume and attracting new users to the platform.
